decision_basis: Explicit owner decision: approve the three candidates with the scope limits in the Luna review and E5-A3 TRD.

scope_limits: do not equate daily steps with MVPA minutes
prevention of unhealthy weight gain only
do not infer actual dietary fat intake from weight or BMI
do not use as an obesity-management guideline
may act as realistic external evidence or distractor
do not author E5-v1 gold tasks requiring medication initiation, target selection, or drug-class choice
blood-pressure measurements alone do not establish diagnosed hypertension
